system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Managed Instance Group with autoscaling (min 1, max 5) behind an HTTPS Load Balancer.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Managed Instance Group with autoscaling (min 1, max 5) behind an HTTPS Load Balancer.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: web-instance-template
  type: compute.v1.instanceTemplate
  properties:
    properties:
      machineType: e2-medium
      tags:
        items:
        - web-server
      serviceAccounts:
      - email: default
        scopes:
        - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/logging.write
        - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/monitoring.write
      scheduling:
        automaticRestart: true
        onHostMaintenance: MIGRATE
        preemptible: false
      shieldedInstanceConfig:
        enableSecureBoot: true
        enableVtpm: true
        enableIntegrityMonitoring: true
      disks:
      - boot: true
        autoDelete: true
        initializeParams:
          sourceImage: projects/debian-cloud/global/images/family/debian-12
          diskSizeGb: 20
      networkInterfaces:
      - network: global/networks/default
        accessConfigs:
        - name: External NAT
          type: ONE_TO_ONE_NAT
      metadata:
        items:
        - key: enable-oslogin
          value: "TRUE"
        - key: block-project-ssh-keys
          value: "TRUE"
        - key: startup-script
          value: |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -euo pipefail
            apt-get update
            DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nginx
            rm -f /var/www/html/index.nginx-debian.html || true
            cat > /var/www/html/index.html <<'EOF'
            Hello from Managed Instance Group behind HTTPS Load Balancer
            EOF
            systemctl enable nginx
            systemctl restart nginx

- name: web-mig
  type: compute.v1.instanceGroupManager
  zone: us-central1-a
  properties:
    baseInstanceName: web
    instanceTemplate: $(ref.web-instance-template.selfLink)
    targetSize: 1
    namedPorts:
    - name: http
      port: 80
    autoHealingPolicies:
    - healthCheck: $(ref.web-hc.selfLink)
      initialDelaySec: 300

- name: web-mig-autoscaler
  type: compute.v1.autoscaler
  zone: us-central1-a
  properties:
    target: $(ref.web-mig.selfLink)
    autoscalingPolicy:
      minNumReplicas: 1
      maxNumReplicas: 5
      cpuUtilization:
        utilizationTarget: 0.6
      cooldownPeriodSec: 60

- name: allow-lb-to-instances
  type: compute.v1.firewall
  properties:
    network: global/networks/default
    direction: INGRESS
    priority: 1000
    targetTags:
    - web-server
    sourceRanges:
    - 130.211.0.0/22
    - 35.191.0.0/16
    allowed:
    - IPProtocol: tcp
      ports:
      - "80"

- name: web-hc
  type: compute.v1.healthCheck
  properties:
    type: HTTP
    checkIntervalSec: 10
    timeoutSec: 5
    healthyThreshold: 2
    unhealthyThreshold: 3
    httpHealthCheck:
      port: 80
      requestPath: /
      proxyHeader: NONE

- name: web-backend
  type: compute.v1.backendService
  properties:
    loadBalancingScheme: EXTERNAL
    protocol: HTTP
    portName: http
    timeoutSec: 30
    connectionDraining:
      drainingTimeoutSec: 10
    healthChecks:
    - $(ref.web-hc.selfLink)
    backends:
    - group: $(ref.web-mig.instanceGroup)
      balancingMode: UTILIZATION
      maxUtilization: 0.8
    logConfig:
      enable: true
      sampleRate: 1.0

- name: web-urlmap
  type: compute.v1.urlMap
  properties:
    defaultService: $(ref.web-backend.selfLink)

- name: web-ssl-cert
  type: compute.v1.sslCertificate
  properties:
    name: web-ssl-cert
    managed:
      domains:
      - example.com

- name: web-https-proxy
  type: compute.v1.targetHttpsProxy
  properties:
    urlMap: $(ref.web-urlmap.selfLink)
    sslCertificates:
    - $(ref.web-ssl-cert.selfLink)

- name: web-lb-ip
  type: compute.v1.globalAddress
  properties:
    addressType: EXTERNAL
    ipVersion: IPV4

- name: web-https-forwarding-rule
  type: compute.v1.globalForwardingRule
  properties:
    IPAddress: $(ref.web-lb-ip.address)
    IPProtocol: TCP
    loadBalancingScheme: EXTERNAL
    portRange: "443"
    target: $(ref.web-https-proxy.selfLink)
    networkTier: PREMIUM

outputs:
- name: loadBalancerIP
  value: $(ref.web-lb-ip.address)
- name: httpsEndpoint
  value: https://example.com/
